questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "AFFLUENT"
questions.explanation: AFFLUENT का अर्थ होता है धनी, समृद्ध या सम्पन्न। Synonym: Wealthy, Prosperous, Opulent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "AFFLUENT"
questions.explanation: AFFLUENT (समृद्ध) का Antonym है Poor (गरीब) या Destitute (दरिद्र).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ADVERSITY"
questions.explanation: ADVERSITY का अर्थ होता है विपत्ति, आपदा या तंगी। Synonym: Hardship, Misfortune, Calamity.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ADVERSITY"
questions.explanation: ADVERSITY (विपत्ति) का Antonym है Prosperity (समृद्धि) या Fortune.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CONCISE"
questions.explanation: CONCISE का अर्थ होता है संक्षिप्त या कम शब्दों में। Synonym: Brief, Succinct, Tersely worded.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CONCISE"
questions.explanation: CONCISE (संक्षिप्त) का Antonym है Verbose (शब्द-बहुल) या Lengthy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS का अर्थ होता है वाचाल या बहुत बातें करने वाला। Synonym: Talkative, Loquacious, Voluble.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS (बातूनी) का Antonym है Taciturn (अल्पभाषी) या Reticent.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A cure or remedy for all diseases, difficulties or ills"
questions.explanation: सभी रोगों का रामबाण इलाज को Panacea (संजीवनी/रामबाण) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme or irrational fear of high places or heights"
questions.explanation: ऊँचाई से अत्यधिक डर को Acrophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme or irrational fear of confined or small closed spaces"
questions.explanation: बंद या संकीर्ण जगहों के डर को Claustrophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A decision, action or statement that cannot be changed or called back"
questions.explanation: जिसे बदला या वापस न लिया जा सके उसे Irrevocable (अटल/अपरिवर्तनीय) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A sound or voice that is impossible to be heard"
questions.explanation: जो ध्वनि सुनाई न दे उसे Inaudible (अश्रव्य) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "At the eleventh hour"
questions.explanation: At the eleventh hour = अंतिम क्षण में, एकदम आखिरी समय पर।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite off more than you can chew"
options: To take on a task or responsibility that is too big
To eat too fast without chewing
questions.explanation: Bite off more than you can chew = क्षमता से अधिक काम का बोझ अपने ऊपर लेना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cry over spilt milk"
options: To feel happy after a loss
To regret or complain about something in the past that cannot be undone
questions.explanation: Cry over spilt milk = व्यर्थ में पछताना (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत)।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Face the music"
options: To accept the unpleasant consequences of one's actions
questions.explanation: Face the music = किए गए कर्मों के अप्रिय परिणामों को भुगतना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Hit the nail on the head"
options: To describe or do something exactly right
To injure one's head with a hammer
questions.explanation: Hit the nail on the head = एकदम सटीक बात कहना या सही निशाना साधना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Scarcely had I entered the room than the phone rang."
questions.explanation: Rule: Scarcely/Hardly के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' आता है, 'than' नहीं। (Correct: when the phone rang).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "The scenery of Kashmir are very charming."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Scenery' अनकाउंटेबल सिंगुलर नाउन है, अतः प्लुरल वर्ब 'are' की जगह 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He gave me a five-hundred rupees note."
questions.explanation: Rule: जब कोई संख्या और नाउन एडजेक्टिव के रूप में कार्य करें (Hyphenated Adjective) तो सिंगुलर रहता है (a five-hundred rupee note).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "The teacher distributed the sweets _____ the students."
questions.explanation: Rule: दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं में बांटने के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है (दो के लिए 'between').

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He was accused _____ theft."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Accuse' के साथ हमेशा preposition 'of' का प्रयोग होता है (Accused of crime).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She died _____ malaria."
questions.explanation: Rule: बीमारी से मौत होने पर 'die of' (die of disease) और घाव/भूख से मृत्यु होने पर 'die from' आता है।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी LIEUTENANT (सैन्य अधिकारी/लेफ्टिनेंट) है।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी COMMISSION (double M, double S) है, जिसका अर्थ आयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the CORRECTLY spelt word:
questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी MAINTENANCE (रखरखाव) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS का अर्थ होता है अत्यधिक सतर्क, सूक्ष्म या सावधान। Synonym: Careful, Painstaking, Fastidious.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS (सावधान) का Antonym है Careless (लापरवाह) या Sloppy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "PRUDENT"
questions.explanation: PRUDENT का अर्थ होता है बुद्धिमान, चतुर या सावधान। Synonym: Wise, Cautious, Judicious.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "PRUDENT"
questions.explanation: PRUDENT (बुद्धिमान/सावधान) का Antonym है Foolish (मूर्ख) या Reckless (बेपरवाह).

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who eats too much food greedily"
questions.explanation: बहुत अधिक पेटू बनकर खाने वाले व्यक्ति को Glutton कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who knows or speaks many languages"
questions.explanation: अनेक भाषाएँ जानने/बोलने वाले व्यक्ति को Polyglot या Multilingual (बहुभाषी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A book, award or child born after the death of its father/author"
questions.explanation: मृत्यु के उपरांत मिलने वाले पुरस्कार, प्रकाशन या शिशु को Posthumous (मरणोपरांत) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where weapons, arms and military equipment are stored"
questions.explanation: शस्त्रागार जहाँ हथियार और गोला-बारूद रखे जाते हैं, उसे Arsenal कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "In the nick of time"
options: Just in time / at the last moment
questions.explanation: In the nick of time = ठीक समय पर, अंतिम क्षण में।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Pull someone's leg"
options: To trip someone making him fall
To tease or joke with someone
questions.explanation: Pull someone's leg = टाँग खींचना, मज़ाक उड़ाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Through thick and thin"
questions.explanation: Through thick and thin = हर सुख-दुख और परिस्थिति में साथ रहना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "No sooner did he see the police <u>when</u> he ran away."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'No sooner' के साथ कंजंक्शन के रूप में सदैव 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' नहीं।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Each of the boys <u>have done their</u> homework."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Each of' के बाद नाउन प्लुरल आता है परंतु वर्ब और प्रोनाउन सिंगुलर (has done his) आते हैं।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They are playing cricket."
options: Cricket is being played by them.
Cricket has been played by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous का Passive = Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "Who broke this glass?"
options: By whom this glass was broken?
By whom is this glass broken?
By whom was this glass broken?
questions.explanation: 'Who' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य का Passive = By whom + was/were + Object + V3?

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: The teacher said, "The earth revolves round the sun."
options: The teacher said that the earth revolved round the sun.
The teacher said that the earth revolves round the sun.
The teacher said the earth revolves.
The teacher told that the earth is revolving round the sun.
questions.explanation: Rule: सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth) वाले वाक्यों का Tense परोक्ष कथन (Indirect Speech) में नहीं बदलता।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said to her, "Please give me your book."
options: He ordered her to give him her book.
He requested her to give him her book.
He asked her please give my book.
He requested her giving him her book.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence में 'Please' हटने पर verb 'requested' बनेगी तथा रिपोर्टेड स्पीच imperative (to give...) बनेगी।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "LUCID"
questions.explanation: LUCID का अर्थ होता है स्पष्ट, सुगम या समझने में आसान। Synonym: Clear, Understandable, Transparent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "LUCID"
questions.explanation: LUCID (स्पष्ट) का Antonym है Confused, Obscure (अस्पष्ट) या Vague.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A poem of lamentation written on the death of a near and dear one"
questions.explanation: किसी व्यक्ति के निधन पर लिखी जाने वाली शोक कविता को Elegy कहते हैं (Epitaph = समाधि लेख)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A speech or presentation made without any prior preparation"
questions.explanation: बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिए गए भाषण को Extempore या Impromptu कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A collection of poems, stories or literary writings"
questions.explanation: विभिन्न कवियों या लेखकों की चुनिंदा कविताओं/कहानियों के संग्रह को Anthology कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी SEPARATE (अलग) है।
